- Build 5 page templates in WordPress (e.g. Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.)
- Use a clean, lightweight theme or builder (no heavy setups)
- Ensure responsive design (mobile + desktop)
- Basic styling to match provided designs
- No complex functionality required

Requirements:
- Experience with WordPress theme/template development
- Ability to follow simple designs accurately
- Keep code clean and simple
- Structure should be ready to support Arabic (RTL) in a later phase

Timeline:
Looking to complete within a few days

I will keep the setup lightweight, either using a clean theme structure or a simple builder only if it helps match the designs without adding unnecessary bloat. I will avoid heavy plugins and complex functionality since your scope is mainly template conversion and basic styling.

The pages will be built to work properly on desktop and mobile, with styling matched closely to the provided designs. I will also keep the code and structure clean so the site can later support Arabic RTL without needing a major rebuild.

I have experience building WordPress corporate websites, custom page templates, responsive layouts, and simple theme-based implementations. I can deliver the first version quickly and then adjust any spacing, typography, or responsive details based on your review.

What we need:
Improve website loading speed and performance
Clean up and optimize the site (fix layout issues, remove unused elements, improve structure)

Add and format new pages/content using Elementor
Ensure mobile responsiveness and consistent design across pages

Requirements:
Strong experience with WordPress + Elementor (this is required)
Experience improving site speed (Core Web Vitals, caching, image optimization, etc.)
Ability to clean up messy or inconsistent page builds
Good design sense and attention to detail
Reliable communication

Nice to have:

Basic SEO knowledge
Ability to suggest improvements (UX, layout, performance)

Examples of Elementor sites you’ve worked on
What specific steps you take to improve WordPress site speed

accepted_proposal.proposal:
Hello, I specialize in WordPress and Elementor maintenance, and your project fits my experience well. I can help clean up the current site, improve page structure, fix layout inconsistencies, replace duplicated headers and footers with a proper global Elementor header/footer, and add or format new pages using Elementor.

For speed improvement, I usually start with an audit using PageSpeed Insights or GTmetrix, then optimize images, remove unused sections/widgets, reduce plugin bloat, configure caching, improve asset loading, check fonts/scripts, and review Core Web Vitals issues such as LCP, CLS, and INP. I will keep the design consistent across pages and make sure the layouts work properly on mobile.

I have worked on Elementor business sites where I cleaned messy page builds, rebuilt global templates using Elementor Theme Builder, improved mobile layouts, and optimized performance. I can share examples of Elementor sites I have worked on. I am available around 20 hours per week and I am interested in a long-term role if the collaboration works well.

Frontend: React.js (Next.js is a plus)
Backend: Node.js (Express.js or NestJS)
Database: MongoDB or PostgreSQL

Core Features (MVP Scope):
User Authentication (Login/Signup)
Dashboard (overview of SEO metrics)
Keyword Tracking System
Website/Project Management (multiple sites per user)
Basic On-Page SEO Audit (meta tags, headings, etc.)
Backlink Tracking Module (manual or API-based)
Report Generation (PDF or dashboard-based)
Subscription System (basic SaaS billing - optional for MVP)

Nice to Have:
Experience with SEO tools or platforms
API integrations (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar)
Clean UI/UX sense
SaaS architecture experience

MVP development (4–6 Days timeline)
Clean and scalable code
Documentation required

3. Estimated timeline
4. Any suggestions for MVP improvement
We are looking to build a long-term relationship for future upgrades.

job_requirements: Build an MVP SEO Management SaaS platform

accepted_proposal.proposal:
Hello, I can build the MVP for your SEO Management SaaS platform using a clean full-stack architecture. For this timeline, I would recommend Next.js for the frontend, Node.js with NestJS or Express for the backend, and PostgreSQL for structured SaaS data such as users, projects, keywords, audits, reports, and subscriptions.

For the MVP, I would focus on login/signup, a dashboard with SEO campaign overview, project management for multiple websites per user, keyword tracking, basic on-page audit checks for title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and indexable pages, a simple backlink tracking module, and dashboard-based or PDF reports. Since the 4-6 day timeline is tight, I would suggest making SaaS billing optional in phase one or implementing a very basic Stripe-ready structure without full subscription automation.

I have worked on SaaS dashboards and SEO-related tools before, including keyword/reporting workflows, API-based data collection, and admin dashboards. I can provide a simple documentation file covering setup, environment variables, architecture, API routes, and future upgrade notes. For future improvements, I would suggest adding scheduled keyword checks, Ahrefs or SEMrush integrations, competitor tracking, and automated email reports after the MVP is stable.

job_desc:
We are seeking an AI and Automation Expert to develop an advanced chatbot designed to manage incoming messages from Facebook Messenger and Instagram DMs, with future scalability to WhatsApp.

The bot's primary objective is twofold: to qualify leads through dynamic filtering and to provide precise customer support based on our internal documentation.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead Qualification: Implement a lead scoring system and dynamic qualifying questions. The system must be easily adjustable to effectively warm up and filter prospects.

AI Knowledge Base: Integrate an AI engine (e.g., DeepSeek) to enable the bot to respond naturally to specific customer inquiries, relying exclusively on the proprietary materials and files we provide.

Multi-Channel Integration: Ensure seamless synchronization across Messenger and Instagram.

Scalability: The architecture should be pre-configured for future integration with the WhatsApp Business API
job_requirements: Prepare architecture for future WhatsApp Business API integration
Make lead qualification rules easily adjustable
Integrate AI engine such as DeepSeek
Use only proprietary internal documentation and files as knowledge source
Synchronize conversations across Messenger and Instagram

accepted_proposal.proposal:
Hello, I can build an AI automation chatbot for Facebook Messenger and Instagram DMs with a scalable structure ready for future WhatsApp Business API integration.

My approach would include three main parts. First, I would create the multi-channel messaging layer to receive and synchronize conversations from Messenger and Instagram. Second, I would build a lead qualification workflow with adjustable scoring rules, dynamic questions, lead stages, and filtering logic so your team can update qualification criteria without rebuilding the bot. Third, I would integrate an AI knowledge base using DeepSeek or another suitable model with retrieval from your internal documents only, so the bot can answer customer questions based strictly on your approved files.

I would also include fallback handling when the answer is not found in the documentation, human handoff rules, conversation logging, and a structure that can later add WhatsApp Business API without redesigning the whole system.

I have experience building chatbot automations, lead qualification flows, AI knowledge-base assistants, and CRM-style message routing. I can start by mapping your lead questions, scoring rules, document sources, and channel requirements, then deliver the first working version in stages.
accepted_proposal.details: Excellent match. The proposal covers Messenger, Instagram, future WhatsApp scalability, lead scoring, dynamic qualifying questions, adjustable rules, AI knowledge base, DeepSeek, proprietary-doc-only answers, synchronization, fallback handling, human handoff, and experience.

job_understanding_evaluation.details: The freelancer understands the core idea but does not explain implementation depth.

requirement_coverage_evaluation.details: Covers many requirements at a high level but lacks precision.

tool_alignment_evaluation.details: Mentions the channels and AI generally but not DeepSeek, proprietary knowledge base, or specific APIs.

language_clarity_evaluation.details: Understandable but grammatically weak and not highly professional.

evidence_of_experience_evaluation.details: Claims to have done automation many times, but without specific examples.
